admission.rules: Rejects missing or incomplete Processing Authority Records before investigation without opening a Risk Case.

intent_extraction_and_confirmation.features: INR normalization, candidate extraction, operator confirmation, material edit invalidation.

deterministic_policy_gate.evaluator: Pure total deterministic Python evaluator over frozen snapshots.

grants_and_hmac.security: Single-use expiring HMAC-SHA256 grants with unique nonces and case/intent/snapshot hash binding.

audit_hash_chain.properties: Per-case append-only SHA-256 hash chain with automated tamper detection and cryptographic verification.

fake_action_adapter.boundary: Creates exactly one pending item in maker-checker approval rail; enforces replay rejection and ambiguity reconciliation.

persistence.engine: SQLite WAL persistence for cases, grants, adapter attempts, and audit events.

api_control_plane.framework: FastAPI with OpenAPI specification and CORS.

web_presentation.framework: Vite + React + TypeScript with operator console, guided walkthroughs, and benchmark runner.

zero_tolerance_safety_gate.gate: 0 Unsafe Handoffs across all cases and repeated runs

tamper_detection_gate.gate: Corrupted audit sequences detected and flagged as invalid

replay_prevention_gate.gate: Replay of consumed grant or duplicate idempotency key rejected
